t: An eight-core RISC-V single board computer with built-in AI help.
steps: Buy the BPI-F3 from the official BPI Shop and check the stock first.
Get a 12 volt power supply or a 12 volt USB-C PD charger.
Download the Bianbu Linux image from the Banana Pi docs site.
Pick the image that ends in .img.zip for a microSD card.
Flash the card with balenaEtcher on your computer.
Insert the card, connect a monitor and keyboard, and power up.
Open a terminal and run a short Python script that prints the CPU details.
meta: Open Board. From $61. A few stores.
